note: Real historical periods replayed through the live index and alert code using ERA5 reanalysis (Open-Meteo archive). ERA5 is a ~25 km grid, so peak values run a few degrees below station records.

scenarios.title: North & Central India heatwave, May 2024
scenarios.context: Prolonged dry heat across Rajasthan, Delhi, UP and MP; IMD stations reported ~50 C at Churu and Phalodi.

scenarios.title: East coast humid heat, late April 2024
scenarios.context: Heatwave over Odisha, Gangetic West Bengal and coastal Andhra Pradesh, with high humidity along the coast.

scenarios.title: Bihar humid heatwave, June 2019
scenarios.context: Humid heat over south Bihar (Gaya, Aurangabad) linked to a large number of heat deaths; delayed monsoon.

scenarios.title: Andhra Pradesh & Telangana heatwave, May 2015
scenarios.context: One of India's deadliest heatwaves, concentrated in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
